sentences.zh: 所以直到我们到了那儿我才真正意识到这一点。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I don't have a couch.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，哦，我连个沙发都没有。

sentences.en: I guess I'll just sit in this one chair.
sentences.zh: 我想我只能坐在这一把椅子上了。

sentences.en: And it was just one of those moments where I was like, God, I'm really immature.
sentences.zh: 那真是那种让我觉得，天哪，我真是不成熟。

sentences.en: I'm really like a lot, I'm just a kid still in some way.
sentences.zh: 我真的挺，某种程度上我依然只是个孩子。

sentences.en: I'm like, there's just no, there's no, all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 我想，根本没有，根本没有，所有那些东西。

sentences.en: Where did that go?
sentences.zh: 那些都去哪儿了？

sentences.en: It was Carter's things.
sentences.zh: 那是卡特的东西。

sentences.en: And he took it to his new apartment.
sentences.zh: 他把它们搬到了他的新公寓里。

sentences.en: And so he was clearly more together than I was.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然比我更有条理。

sentences.en: And I had to quickly go out and buy all this furniture because I was like, oh, it just didn't magically appear here.
sentences.zh: 我不得不赶紧跑出去买齐所有的家具，因为我想，哦，它们不会自己凭空出现在这里。

sentences.en: But yeah, those places in your twenties, they have a kind of meaning.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，你在二十多岁时的那些住处，它们有着某种特殊的意义。

sentences.en: And those, you know, you'll never live quite like that again.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你再也不会那样生活了。

sentences.en: And, and yeah, I think that one on 75th street for Carter and I would be like the, that's the Marshall and Ted apartment.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我觉得75街的那套公寓对卡特和我来说，就像是，那就是马歇尔和泰德的公寓。

sentences.en: And also it occurs to me that in the grand, if you really zoom up and take in the grand perspective, like there's no such thing as a home forever, like a forever home, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我也意识到，从宏观来看，如果你把视野拉大，从宏观视角来看，根本没有什么永远的家，比如所谓的终极住宅，你知道的，

sentences.en: they will, you know, they'll all go away.
sentences.zh: 它们会的，你知道的，它们都会消失的。

sentences.en: I mean, at some point you're probably going to want to move into a home that doesn't have stairs.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某个时候你可能想搬到一个没有楼梯的家里。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like you've got to, you've got to adapt your, your notion of what home is like.
sentences.zh: 就像你必须，你必须调整你对家的概念。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like I, I, I try not to talk too much about my relationship on here, but I, it comes up, but I, I,
sentences.zh: 就像我，我，我尽量不在节目里多谈我的感情，但它确实会出现，不过我，我，

sentences.en: I had this feeling about Jordana when I was falling in love with her and that I was pretty sure we were going to get married is she had this feeling that I knew wherever we went,
sentences.zh: 我在爱上乔丹娜的时候有这种感觉，我相当确信我们要结婚了，她当时有这种感觉，我知道无论我们走到哪里，

sentences.en: it would feel like home.
sentences.zh: 都会感觉像家一样。

sentences.en: Like, like us together felt like home, not the structure of wherever we were.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们在一起的感觉就像家，而不是无论我们在哪里的那个建筑结构。

sentences.en: That's, that's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's all home can ever be.
sentences.zh: 家一直以来也就只能是这样。

sentences.en: I think really.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that needs to be a, a movable feast to go all Hemingway about it.
sentences.zh: 而且这需要是一场流动的盛宴，用海明威的话来说。

sentences.en: You need, it needs to, it will have to travel.
sentences.zh: 你需要，它需要，它将不得不去旅行。

sentences.en: And you need sometimes, I mean, hopefully not for horrifying geopolitical reasons, but sometimes you got to pick up and go, you know, sometimes you got to like,
sentences.zh: 有时你需要，我是说，希望不是出于可怕的地缘政治原因，但有时你得收拾东西就走，你知道，有时你得像，

sentences.en: it's where you get a job or like we have to be adaptable enough.
sentences.zh: 这是你找到工作的地方，或者说我们必须具备足够的适应能力。

sentences.en: And again, this comes back to this notion of, this is, we're kind of fusing the two great themes that we've talked about in, but in the dual episodes, right?
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这回到了这个概念，这是，我们有点把我们在前后两集里讨论过的两个伟大主题融合在一起了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But like this notion of change, uh, being this constant force resisting it, but also getting for, it will win.
sentences.zh: 但就像这种改变的概念，呃，作为一种恒定的力量去抗拒它，但同时去获取它，它会赢。

sentences.en: It will always win.
sentences.zh: 它总是会赢。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then this notion of home being, uh, uh, uh, not a, quite a permanent thing.
sentences.zh: 然后这种家的概念是，呃，呃，呃，不是一个那么永久的东西。

sentences.en: Although, you know, one of the things that, um, people always get upset about if you live in New York city and then you watch shows about New York city,
sentences.zh: 虽然，你知道，其中有一件事，嗯，人们总是感到沮丧的是，如果你住在纽约市，然后你看关于纽约市的节目，

sentences.en: that the apartments are too big for the income bracket of the people living in them.
sentences.zh: 里面的公寓对于住在里面的人的收入阶层来说太大了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's a Peter Hedges movie that, uh, our friend Katie Holmes started in called Pieces of April, which if you haven't seen that movie is a fantastic movie.
sentences.zh: 有一部彼得·海吉斯的电影，呃，我们的朋友凯蒂·霍尔姆斯主演的，叫《四月的碎片》，如果你没看过那部电影，那真是一部极好的电影。

sentences.en: I remember loving that movie.
sentences.zh: 我记得我很喜欢那部电影。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Patty Clarkson, Oliver Platt, John Gallagher, Alison Pilt, great movie.
sentences.zh: 派翠西娅·克拉克森、奥利弗·普莱特、约翰·加拉赫、艾莉森·皮尔，伟大的电影。

sentences.en: Um, and, uh, she, and, uh, the, the apartment in there is like, I don't know how they filmed it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，呃，她，呃，里面的那间公寓，就像，我不知道他们是怎么拍的。

sentences.en: And the reason that you can't have super small apartments is because you can't fill a whole film.
sentences.zh: 你不能有超级小的公寓的原因是，你无法拍满整部电影。

sentences.en: It's really hard to shoot in.
sentences.zh: 在里面拍摄真的很难。

sentences.en: It's really hard to shoot.
sentences.zh: 真的很难拍。

sentences.en: So, but that, they made that apartment look very small and very appropriate.
sentences.zh: 所以，但那个，他们把那间公寓弄得看起来很小而且非常合适。

sentences.en: But there is something about this Upper West Side apartment in 2005 that I do buy that through some real estate miracle stroke of luck in New York city,
sentences.zh: 但2005年上西区的这间公寓确实有某种特质，我是相信的，通过纽约市的某种房地产奇迹或运气，

sentences.en: they would have been able to get something.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以弄到这样一套房。

sentences.en: It's not completely implausible.
sentences.zh: 这并不是完全不可信的。

sentences.en: And the way we tended to it too, it's a little bigger maybe than what they could have got.
sentences.zh: 而且我们对待它的方式也是，可能比他们实际能买到的要稍微大一点。

sentences.en: But we, we said to our wonderful set designer who won multiple Emmys, Steve Olsen, we said, it's probably still going to be a little too big.
sentences.zh: 但我们，我们对我们荣获多项艾美奖的布景设计师史蒂夫·奥尔森说，这可能还是会稍微有点大。

sentences.en: Let's not make it crazy big.
sentences.zh: 我们别把它弄得大得离谱。

sentences.en: I know it has to be a little big to shoot in and for logistics, but let's scuff it up.
sentences.zh: 我知道为了拍摄和后勤需要它得稍微大一点，但让我们把它弄旧一点。

sentences.en: Let's have the paint be not perfect and bright and amazing and not look like a set for a Hollywood show being shot in Los Angeles about New York.
sentences.zh: 让油漆不要那么完美、鲜艳和惊艳，看起来不要像是在洛杉矶拍摄的关于纽约的好莱坞节目的布景。

sentences.en: You know, I remember, I don't remember what season it was, but I don't think this was a set design thing, but there,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我记得，我不记得是哪一季了，但这大概不是布景设计的问题，但是，

sentences.en: there was a screw that was sticking out of the door and everyone kept like, like, nicking their thumb on it.
sentences.zh: 有一颗螺丝从门里凸出来，每个人都一直像，像把大拇指刮伤了。

sentences.en: And we had to keep asking them to screw it in because everyone was getting injured.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不一直要求他们把它拧进去，因为每个人都在受伤。

sentences.en: Cause you know, you bust in and out of those doors so faSt.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，你进出那些门太快了。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's really funny.
sentences.zh: 那真的很好笑。

sentences.en: I don't think I ever knew that detail.
sentences.zh: 我想我以前从来不知道这个细节。

sentences.en: I just want to say, by the way, that Steve Olsen is a listener to this show.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我想说史蒂夫·奥尔森是这个节目的听众。

sentences.en: He comments, he comments on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 他会留言，他在Instagram上留言。

sentences.en: Steve, Steve Olsen, the great Steve Olsen.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，史蒂夫·奥尔森，伟大的史蒂夫·奥尔森。

sentences.en: I don't think it was Steve's fault.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这不是史蒂夫的错。

sentences.en: The, uh, the, the screw on the door.
sentences.zh: 那个，呃，那个，门上的螺丝。

sentences.en: Steve is great.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫太棒了。

sentences.en: Steve lived in New York and, uh, he really, he lived in New York for a lot of years too.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫住在纽约，呃，他真的，他在纽约也住了很多年。

sentences.en: And he actually lived right next to the late show with David Letterman, uh, studio, like the Ed Sullivan theater.
sentences.zh: 而且他其实就住在“大卫·莱特曼深夜秀”呃，摄影棚隔壁，就像埃德·沙利文剧院那样。

sentences.en: And knew when we said, we want to make, uh, McLaren's kind of like the Bar McGee's.
sentences.zh: 当听我们说，我们想让麦克拉伦酒吧有点像麦吉酒吧时。

sentences.en: Have you been there?
sentences.zh: 你去过那儿吗？

sentences.en: And he said, I've been there 10,000 times.
sentences.zh: 他说，我去过一万次了。

sentences.en: I lived right around the corner from there.
sentences.zh: 我就住在转角不远的地方。

sentences.en: He was even featured on a Dave Letterman, meet the neighbors segment.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还在大卫·莱特曼的“走近邻居”环节里出过镜。

sentences.en: You know how Dave would just send his camera around.
sentences.zh: 你知道大卫以前总会把摄像机派出去。

sentences.en: They knocked on Steve Olsen's door and Steve was on late show with Dave Letterman, like talking to Dave down in the studio on the camera.
sentences.zh: 他们敲了史蒂夫·奥尔森的门，史蒂夫就上了大卫·莱特曼的深夜秀，就像在镜头前和摄影棚里的大卫说话一样。

sentences.en: Like he was, so when we said, uh, we were trying to hire a set designer.
sentences.zh: 就像他，所以当我们说，呃，我们正试图雇佣一个布景设计时。

sentences.en: It's the fact that Steve like knew the bars, like yep, the murals, the red boots.
sentences.zh: 事实是史蒂夫了解这些酒吧，比如没错，壁画，红靴子。

sentences.en: I know exactly what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我完全知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: So it was like kind of one of those destiny moments when we met Steve.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们遇到史蒂夫时，这有点像是命中注定的时刻之一。

sentences.en: So shout out to Steve Olsen and, uh, yeah, one of the many amazing people that came to create the universe of Himyam.
sentences.zh: 所以向史蒂夫·奥尔森致敬，呃，是的，他是创造《老爸老妈浪漫史》宇宙的众多了不起的人之一。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, thank you all so much again.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家再次收听。

sentences.zh: 到处都是精彩的问题。

sentences.zh: 请把它们发到YouTube、Instagram以及我们的网站，呃，howwemadeyourmother斜杠contact。

sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我们，我们下期见。
